'''Waks Burr''' was an [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] who frequented the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="CSWE" /> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of<ref name="CSWE22">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="FF" /> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CSWE" /> During a [[Local day/Legends|night]]<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|96|OUT 1-2|Outlander Nightclub Patrons}}</ref> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Burr was visiting the club<ref name="FF" /> when the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] ran into the club to hide from the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] after she tried to [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassinate]] the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="aotc">{{Film|II}}</ref> Being an Ishi Tib, Burr added to the interplanetary feel of the club on that night.<ref name="FF" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Harc-seff.jpg|thumb|right|250px|An image of Harc Seff (pictured) was used to represent Waks Burr.]]
Waks Burr was first mentioned in the [[May 2]], [[2003]], [[StarWars.com]] article "[[Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases.]]" Burr's name appeared in an image documenting characters from the Outlander Club sequence of the [[2002]] [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], though instead of the image showing a character from the film, Burr's name was applied to<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref> the Ishi Tib [[Harc Seff/Legends|Harc Seff]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Harc Seff}}</ref> As other characters with the same image errors where later identified as characters in Episode II,<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|75|Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night}}</ref> this article assumes that Waks Burr is one of the many Ishi Tib visiting the Outlander Club in the film, but refrains from assuming which member of the [[Species/Legends|species]] Burr is.
